name: 01-welcome-login
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished production-quality UI concept board for Uni Companion, university-only React Native Android course study and discussion app. TWO full portrait app screens side-by-side, edge to edge, crisp readable text, minimal neutral gutter, no phone hardware, no perspective, no outside marketing captions. Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: preserve its cobalt blue primary, white surfaces, navy ink, rounded bold sans-serif headings, readable regular body, tactile rounded buttons with shallow dark-blue bottom edge, icon weight, and original orange star mascot with expressive navy eyes, short arms, cobalt sneakers. Draw new screen layouts. Original art direction, playful consumer quality like Duolingo, not a copy. Clean Android safe areas, generous tap targets, disciplined whitespace, moderate heading sizes. No serif, no cream/forest-green styling, no decorative gradients, no emoji icons, no fake provider logos. Mascot small and purposeful except welcome, never repeated on same screen. Use fictional sample data. LEFT WELCOME: Uni Companion wordmark, large original orange star carrying a blue notebook, confident headline 'Your courses. Your people.', short line 'Understand your notes, practise, and learn together.' Cobalt primary 'Get started', outlined 'I already have an account'. No bottom navigation. RIGHT LOGIN: back navigation, friendly 'Good to see you.', small waving mascot near heading. Explicit Email and Password field labels, sample placeholder 'Your university email', password visibility icon, 'Forgot password?' link, prominent 'Log in' button, bottom 'New here? Create an account'. Only email/password, no Google/Apple sign-in, no social controls, no fake university logo. Forms practical with space reserved for keyboard scrolling.
